title: I Vow to Thee, My Country

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Dm]The love that asks the [Gm/D]reason, the love that stands [Cm/G]the [Bb]test,
[Bb/F]That lays upon [F]the [Gm]altar the [F]dearest and the best;
[F]The love that never [Gm]falters, [Cm]the [Bb]love that pays the [Eb/Bb]price,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Eb/Bb]Most dear [Dm/A]to [Bb]them that love her, most [Eb]great to them [F/C]that know;
[Dm]We may not count her [Gm/D]armies, we may not see [Cm/G]her [Bb]King;
[Bb/F]Her fortress [F]is a faithful [Gm]heart, [F]her pride is suffering;
[F]And one by one and [Gm]fervently [Cm]we [Bb]pray for her increase,
